nodes.name: Read Lane (Stage A)
nodes.notes: ADR-061 Block 1: reads config.agent_lane so Build Prompt can gate the floor (managed -> floor only, tail pulled on demand; bare -> full assembly, since the dormant failover cannot pull tools). Mirrors the orchestrator's Read Agent Lane. Fail-safe: onError continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData so a DB error still emits an item and Build Prompt defaults to bare/full (no managed run is ever starved).

parameters.query: select value as agent_lane from public.config where key = 'agent_lane' limit 1;
